Warning  Failed  Error: couldn't find key msg in ConfigMap default/app-config

So the new ReplicaSet (`app-746889749f`) could never create a pod — it sat at `1 desired / 0 ready`, while the previous working template (`app-845b8b8485`, key `message`) was stuck with its own three pods, giving `replicas=4, unavailableReplicas=1`.

The persistent owner of the faulty state was the Deployment's pod template. The ConfigMap is unchanged and already contains a meaningful key (`message`), so no data was added — I corrected the one invalid reference in the Deployment spec to point at the existing key:

```yaml
spec.template.spec.containers[0].env = [{name: CONFIG_MESSAGE,
  valueFrom.configMapKeyRef:{key: message, name: app-config}}]
```
